fusions.name: Left-In Barb
fusions.desc: Stings an enemy up to 3 tiles away for 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each use costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Stirred Hive
fusions.desc: Whirls through the enemies around you, dealing 10 damage to everything within 2 tiles. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tireless Prowl
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds and increases your movement speed by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hum of the Chase
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
